path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute). It must be a regular text file: directories, devices, FIFOs and binary files are rejected before any write.

old_string.description: Exact non-empty text to replace. It must match file content exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once unless replace_all is true.

new_string.description: Replacement text. It must differ from old_string and may be empty to delete the matched text.

replace_all.description: Replace every exact occurrence of old_string. Defaults to false.

workdir.description: Optional absolute directory used to resolve a relative path. It is never inherited from another call, a session default, cwd, or home directory. Omit it for an absolute path; a relative path without an explicit workdir is rejected. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~' or environment-variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.
